# Kimber Sykes

> Kimber Sykes is a London-based freelance Executive Producer, Production Manager and Technical Director, delivering large-scale corporate events worldwide for agencies and brands across B2B tech conferences, consumer brand activations and sports sponsorship programmes.

Kimber Sykes has 23 years of experience in live events and has delivered work on site in 18 countries. He is based in London and works worldwide, usually engaged by agencies to lead production for their clients. Role credits on this site are stated exactly as given on each project.

## Profile

- Name: Kimber Sykes
- Roles: Executive Producer, Production Manager, Technical Director
- Based: London, United Kingdom; works worldwide
- Experience: 23 years
- Sectors: B2B tech conferences, Consumer brand activations, Sports sponsorship programmes
- Specialisms: Executive production, Event production management, Technical direction, B2B technology conferences, Consumer brand activations, Experiential marketing, Sports sponsorship activations, Live event production, Audio-visual technical delivery, Show flow and run of show, Exhibition floor management, Touring event programmes
- Clients include: Google, Google Cloud, Netflix, Canva, Geely, Mastercard, Visa, Emirates, Emirates SkyCargo, Samsung, Johnson & Johnson, Stella McCartney, Aperol, MTV, Microsoft, Xero, NTT Data, Electronic Arts, Sony, Diageo, Philips, SoundCloud, Peugeot, Infiniti, Jaguar, American Express, Commonwealth Bank, Walt Disney, Instagram, Lilly, Destination NSW, CNN, Marriott Group, Tourism NT, B Braun, dnata, DP World, Expo 2020, Gunpowder Plot, Intercontinental Hotels, Jumeirah Hotels, Pfizer, Reed Elsevier, Rizla, Schwarzkopf, Tiger, Yoto
- Agencies worked with include: Wonder, Jack Morton, Amplify, INVNT, Imagination, Octagon, Pulse Group, BMF, Curiious, AGB Events, Yakusan, Emotive, We Are Listen, Exposure, K&K Productions, Bacchus, Blondefish, Akcelo

## Services

### Executive Production

- [Executive Production on the About page](https://kimbersykes.com/about#executive-production)

As Executive Producer, Kimber owns a project for the agency from brief to derig: the client relationship, budget, supplier network and freelance delivery team. He delivered Canva Studio in London from concept to delivery in six weeks.

What's included:
- Client and agency stakeholder management
- Budget ownership and cost planning
- Supplier sourcing and procurement
- Building and leading freelance production teams
- Delivery to compressed timelines
- Live event execution

Typical projects: Brand and product launches, pop-ups and experiential activations, innovation and sustainability exhibits, and sports sponsorship activations.

Case studies: [Canva Studio Pop-Up](https://kimbersykes.com/work/canva-studio), [Geely Auto: EX5 Brand Launch](https://kimbersykes.com/work/geely-auto), [Stella McCartney: Sustainable Market at COP28](https://kimbersykes.com/work/stella-mccartney-cop28), [Yoto PlayDate London 2026](https://kimbersykes.com/work/yoto-playdate-london-2026), [Visa Everywhere Initiative](https://kimbersykes.com/work/visa-everywhere), [Aperol Spritz: Australian Open](https://kimbersykes.com/work/aperol-spritz)

### Production Management

- [Production Management on the About page](https://kimbersykes.com/about#production-management)

As Senior Production Manager, Kimber runs production on site across large multi-room conferences, covering AV, staging, show flow, crew and contractors. He has led production on Google Cloud Summit London at Tobacco Dock for three consecutive years, with 2,500+ attendees and up to nine rooms running in parallel.

What's included:
- Production schedules, show flow and run of show
- AV, staging and room coordination
- Crew and contractor management, including bespoke sign-in software for 1,000+ contractors
- Speaker and moderator support
- Live troubleshooting and room changeovers
- Technical pre-production

Typical projects: Multi-room B2B conferences and summits, exhibitions and immersive fan experiences.

Case studies: [Google Cloud Summit London 2026](https://kimbersykes.com/work/google-cloud-summit-2026), [Google Cloud Summit London 2025](https://kimbersykes.com/work/google-cloud-summit-2025), [Google Cloud Summit London 2024](https://kimbersykes.com/work/google-cloud-summit-2024), [Netflix: Stranger Things Fan Experience](https://kimbersykes.com/work/netflix-stranger-things)

### Technical Direction

- [Technical Direction on the About page](https://kimbersykes.com/about#technical-direction)

As Technical Director, Kimber keeps stages, broadcast feeds, AV and exhibition floors technically aligned and on schedule, working between the agency's creative team and its technical suppliers. Recent work includes Xerocon in Nashville, London and Denver for INVNT.

What's included:
- Technical pre-production and design review
- Stage, AV and broadcast coordination
- Exhibition floor installation
- On-site supplier and crew coordination
- Technical support for overseas production teams

Typical projects: Flagship conferences with multiple stages and broadcast, exhibition floors, and technology-led installations and projection.

Case studies: [Xerocon Denver 2026](https://kimbersykes.com/work/xerocon-denver-2026), [Xerocon London 2026](https://kimbersykes.com/work/xerocon-london-2026), [Xerocon Nashville](https://kimbersykes.com/work/xerocon-nashville), [Microsoft x London College of Fashion](https://kimbersykes.com/work/microsoft-lcf), [Expo 2020: UAE National Day Celebration](https://kimbersykes.com/work/expo-2020)

## Career summary

- 2015 to present: Freelance, Worldwide. Executive Producer, Senior Production Manager, Technical Director and Project Lead. Engaged by agencies including Wonder, INVNT, Jack Morton, Amplify, Curiious, Octagon, Imagination and BMF to lead production on conferences, brand activations and sports sponsorship programmes.
- 2012 to 2015: Pulse Group, London. Senior Producer and Account Director. Project led the Emirates Aviation Experience at Greenwich Peninsula with a hand-built team of 40 (c. GBP 7 million), and worked across Emirates' global sports sponsorship programme. Clients included Emirates, NTT Data, dnata, Bentley, DP World, Intercontinental Hotels and Jumeirah Hotels.
- 2011: Exposure, London. Producer. Produced the live programme for Rizlab, Experiments in Music, for Rizla.
- 2008 to 2011: t7 event solutions, Sydney. Producer. Clients included American Express, B Braun, CBA, Jaguar, Pfizer, Sony and Telstra. Nominated for Meeting and Event Association Australian Young Professional of the Year 2010.
- 2003 to 2007: Everest Event Enterprises, Sydney. Principal. Founded a small business providing staffing support for the events industry.
